rationale: Tests knowledge of the five occupational hazard categories covered in the content block on hazard classification.
Tests recall of silicosis as the most common pneumoconiosis — a fundamental fact from Park's textbook covered in the pneumoconioses content block.
Tests knowledge of ESI contribution rates — a commonly examined factual detail from the ESI Act 1948 covered in the ESI Scheme content block.
Tests understanding of the Factories Act threshold for mandatory appointment of a Safety Officer — covered in the factory-level occupational health services block.
Tests application of HIV PEP protocol — a key clinical skill covered in the biological hazards content block, relevant to needlestick injury management.
Tests understanding of latex allergy as a chemical/physical hazard for healthcare workers — covered in the chemical, physical and ergonomic hazards content block.
